subject: Cross-team ramp thermometer + QBR asks: gaps in playbook, pricing, docs, support readiness
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@helixhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-team ramp thermometer + QBR asks: gaps in playbook, pricing, docs, support readiness

Team —

As we close the quarter I want a concise, cross-functional status snapshot for the Helix Health pilot (RWI-1247) that I can bring to the QBR on Friday. High-level asks below — please treat this as an intentional "thermometer" (green/amber/red) plus the single most important unblock per function.

1) GTM / Enablement (Marissa) — status on enablement materials and frontline training cadence. One-sentence readiness and the single missing asset.
2) Pricing / Commercial (Karthik) — any outstanding procurement terms Helix flagged; confirm final sticker vs negotiated band and whether we need leadership approval for concession.
3) Product Docs / Developer Guides (Naomi) — doc coverage for integration paths (SDK, webhooks), known gaps, and which doc(s) must be published before sign-off.
4) Support / Ops (Laura) — on-call coverage plan for pilot start, known runbook gaps, and whether the support SLA needs an exception.

Attachments: draft playbook + pricing matrix + support questions (linked below). I will compile your inputs into a one-page QBR brief. Please reply with the thermometer color and the one unblock by EOD today (Aug 10).

Related: drive folder with playbook draft and a short form for feedback: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bQBR-Playbook-Draft
HubSpot deal: RWI-1247

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of GTM Operations, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments (stubs): launch_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 4 pages); pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (XLSX); support_runbook_questions.docx (DOCX)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cross-team ramp thermometer + QBR asks: gaps in playbook, pricing, docs, support readiness

Irene — quick update: AMBER.

- Readiness: Enablement deck 85% (slides + playbook snippets are in the Drive). Need final API examples and 2 customer-facing troubleshooting scripts.
- Single unblock: Naomi to confirm the final SDK example (auth + error handling) so we can finalize slide 12 and the quickstart lab.
- Timeline: if we get the sample by 3pm PST today I can fold it into the lab and publish the enablement package tomorrow morning.

Note: frontline training is scheduled for Tue/Wed next week (two 45-minute sessions). Will add the recording link to the playbook when published.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Enablement
marissa.cole@redwood.com

To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@helixhealth.com>, Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 14:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-team ramp thermometer + QBR asks: gaps in playbook, pricing, docs, support readiness

Irene / team — GREEN/AMBER hybrid. Commercially: pricing band confirmed with Helix but procurement asked for two items that are routine but need sign-off:

1) A short-term data retention exception (12 months) versus our standard 6 months for pilot telemetry. Legal has reviewed and is OK with exec-level approval.
2) A small SLA credit carve-out for pilot (max 3% credit window) to be documented in the MSA addendum.

Single unblock: Need a one-line approval from Revenue leadership for the retention exception. If we get that today, procurement will sign next-day.

Attached: pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (stub).

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Strategy
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-team ramp thermometer + QBR asks: gaps in playbook, pricing, docs, support readiness

Irene —

Status: AMBER. Docs coverage is solid for the core flow, but we currently lack two developer examples (async webhook retry logic; multi-tenant auth snippet for Helix's integration pattern). Those are blocking front-line labs and the SDK quickstart.

Single unblock: I will deliver both snippets as a combined gist by 3pm PT today. Once published I'll ping Marissa to include them in the enablement deck.

I've added a short checklist to the Drive folder indicating which pages must be live pre-sign-off. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bQBR-Playbook-Draft

-Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Principal Technical Writer, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

Folks —

Support: GREEN. Ops runbook QA complete for the pilot scope. We have primary and secondary on-call coverage for the first two weeks, and runbook items are marked in the Drive playbook.

One caveat: the support runbook questions doc contains a small open item around escalation contact info for Helix's security team. If Helix can confirm the security contact by EOD Thursday, we do not need an SLA exception. If they cannot, we should plan for the SLA carve-out Karthik mentioned.

I'll package a short one-pager for the QBR: support readiness (green) + known dependency (security contact).

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Manager, Customer Support Operations
laura.bennett@redwood.com
